pros: Securely manages shared passwords for client projects across the team.
Granular user access controls and permissions simplify onboarding and offboarding.
Affordable solution with robust features for a small business.
cons: Initial setup and organization of shared vaults took some time.
Occasional issues with the browser extension not syncing or requiring re-login.
Separate interfaces for personal vault and organization management can be confusing.
changed: Con 3: 'Learning curve for some advanced team management features' was replaced by 'Separate interfaces for personal vault and organization management can be confusing' because the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed' directly points to a specific, significant structural friction rather than a general learning curve.
